practice.title: Practice
practice.translationHint: Hide the English translation by default while practicing. Toggle it anytime with <keys></keys>.

prose.title: Reading text
prose.description: How the reader draws a lesson. Set what you like under All languages, then correct one language if its script needs different treatment. These settings stay on this device.
prose.customisedNotice: {language} has settings of its own. Everything you leave alone still follows All languages.
prose.inheritedNotice: {language} follows your All languages settings. Move a slider and save to correct one of them.
prose.statusUnsaved: The sample above shows your changes. Save to apply them to the reader.
prose.statusDefaults: The defaults are {fontSize}px, weight {fontWeight}, kerning 0 and leading {lineHeight}.
prose.statusResetLanguage: A reset makes {language} follow All languages again.

fontSize.label: Font size
fontSize.hint: How big the body text of a lesson is.

letterSpacing.label: Kerning
letterSpacing.hint: Space between the letters. A negative value tightens them.

lineHeight.label: Leading
lineHeight.hint: Space between the lines, as a multiple of the font size.

tts.title: Text-to-Speech
tts.noAudioNote: {language} has no synthesized voice. Pronunciation is disputed, so Readfox stays silent.
tts.espeakNote: {language} is spoken by eSpeak NG, a synthesized voice hosted by Readfox — the only text-to-speech engine that exists for {language}. It sounds robotic but pronounces every word exactly, and it's included on every plan.
tts.engineHintFree: Browser speech stays free and works across reading, practice, and dictation. Cloud adds a consistent managed voice.
tts.engineHintPaid: Managed voices offer more consistent pronunciation; your browser voice is always available.
tts.upsell: Want Readfox's managed voice? <link>Upgrade to Cloud</link>. Adding your own AI key does not change audio because voice usage is hosted by Readfox.

timezone.title: Time Zone
timezone.description: Daily stats, streaks and review days roll over at midnight in this time zone.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: The language picker lists these languages. Remove a language to shorten the list. Your words, texts and cards in it stay on the server.

knownWords.title: Import Known Words
knownWords.description: Import words you already know. Supports LingQ exports (with status levels and translations) or simple word lists.
knownWords.lingqHelp: LingQ: Vocabulary → Settings gear → Export LingQs → Upload the CSV here
knownWords.uploadHint: CSV with words in the first column, or a plain text file
knownWords.imported: Successfully imported {count, plural, one {# word} other {# words}} as known.
knownWords.noTermColumn: Could not find 'term' column in LingQ export.
knownWords.lingqImported: Imported {count, plural, one {# word} other {# words}} from LingQ: {known} known, {learning} learning.

export.knownDone: Exported {count, plural, one {# known word} other {# known words}}.
